steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each account is matched to the roster. An account not on the roster is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Account not on the roster
findings.fix: Remove the account or add it to the roster

findings.title: Privileged right with no approval
findings.fix: Record the approval or revoke the right

findings.title: Dormant privileged account
findings.fix: Disable the account or record why it is needed

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] acct-03.csv:12  Account not on the roster.
       Fix: Remove the account or add it to the roster.
[high] acct-05.csv:19  Privileged right with no approval.
       Fix: Record the approval or revoke the right.
[medium] acct-06.csv:26  Dormant privileged account.
       Fix: Disable the account or record why it is needed.
Not checked: Access granted outside the list.
pros: Flags an account not on the roster, a privileged right with no approval, and a dormant privileged account.
cons: Not checked: Access granted outside the list.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-access-review skill on the records for this review.
